text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And paste it on at the end... How's this, 
Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all set! The torn poster is put back 
together nicely. Hehe, thanks for helping 
me fix it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, you're welcome♪ Hey hey, didn't 
this turn into a "circle of kindness"?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ! Oh my...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you hurry up and replace such a 
fragile iron ball that shatters from mere 
training?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That... may be true, but... Still, this 
equipment worked hard for our training, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In order to keep the "circle of kindness" 
going— I really want to fix it if I can.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, how sweet of you. ...Alright, let me 
see it. If I pressure-weld it, it should 
last a bit longer."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, here's mine too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I saw 
Victoire Pisa with a relaxed smile on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, lately it feels like everyone is 
connecting so many things together... It 
really warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, what in the world do they mean by 
this "circle of kindness" everyone keeps 
talking about?

"Oh? Could it be that you don't know, 
Pisa-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain! The "Circle of 
Kindness" is a... jinx? Activity? ...type 
thing that's quietly becoming a trend at 
the academy right now!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Those who are apart, or feeling lonely— 
connect them with kindness."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because that kindness will surely come 
full circle and bring happiness to 
everyone." —Something like that!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what a wonderful activity...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, Pisa... You really don't know...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I had no idea due to my limited 
knowledge. To think that such a warm 
"circle" was spreading through the 
academy—!
choice_data_list:
That's just the kind of way Pisa would 
think.

That's just the kind of way Pisa would 
think.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well of course~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—Because the whole "circle of kindness" 
started with you, Pisa-chan.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, a scarf caught on a tree branch... I 
wonder if the wind blew it away.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And so, if we tie it here... hopefully it 
will find its way back to its owner.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, it should be right around here...! Ah, 
my scarf! Thank goodness, someone tied it 
up here for me...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —...or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I do recall that matter, yes... But could 
something like that really be all it 
is...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, besides that... She also reorganized 
the bookshelves where everything was 
scattered, sorting all the books back into 
their proper series.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Casually helping girls make up after 
they've had a fight...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, seeing Pisa-chan connect so many 
things so gently—everyone started copying 
her☆

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, I just... end up wanting to hold 
hands, so I hold it, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if that 'circle of kindness'... if 
everyone's kindness has connected 
together—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case... hehe. I am truly, 
deeply honored♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It is precisely because Pisa-san is 
this kind of person that this 'circle' of 
ours has expanded so widely."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Right☆ Falco and the others were just 
thinking maybe we should try 'connecting' 
various things after this too~"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is studying how to connect hearts 
with all her fans! I want everyone to know 
how important connecting really is!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking of helping out some lost 
gadgets~. Hehe... Wanna come along too, 
Pisa-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think I will take part in activities to 
protect ladybugs. As a member of the 
'Ladybug Care Society'.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, they all sound so intriguing... If 
it pleases you, allow me to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm not sure which one I should 
help with... Trainer, if you don't mind, 
could you share your opinion?
choice_data_list:
Connecting with the fans heart-to-heart 
sounds like it could be fun.
How about I help out with the gadgets?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
――NEXT FRONTIER♪ Push forward with all 
your might♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...How was that? Practicing a live 
performance right in front of Falco-san 
feels terribly presumptuous, though."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, it's super educational~! There's so 
much to learn from watching other 
Umamusume perform☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"For example... like how you make sure to 
look at every single corner of the crowd 
while you're singing! You really keep your 
eyes on your fans, huh? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. I want to make it a 
concert... that leaves no one behind.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
After cleaning inside the keyboard, attach 
the keys—and hup.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a perfect fit! Hehe, not bad at all. 
This should keep working hard for a good 
while longer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored ♪ ...Even gadgets that 
were going to be thrown away can be used 
again if repaired like this—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful endeavor, isn't it? It 
makes me want to fix every single one ♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're pretty interested in this 
stuff, Pisa-chan? Then how about we hit up 
some junk shops together sometime? We 
might just find some hidden treasures♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A ladybug, in a place like this... Someone 
might step on it, I must guide it to a 
safe place.
choice_data_list: So this is the "Ladybug Care Society"...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Protecting the bond between ladybugs and 
people... Fufu, what a truly wonderful 
organization.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a ladybug over here too. 
...Though, it doesn't seem very 
energetic...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you by chance feeling hungry? I 
will prepare a meal, so please wait a 
moment."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Wirklich? To think you could empathize 
with a ladybug's feelings this much... 
Please, you must formally join our 
club...!"
